prompts.overview:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished final mobile game UI concept image, portrait 1024x1536. This is the FIRST of three tab states of the SAME jackpot popup, tab "奖池总览" selected. Reference image 1 is the V8-new visual language; reference image 2 is a recent V8-new tab design. Borrow their rich medium-bright azure/teal blue glass panels, refined pale champagne-gold edges, warm ivory text, strong readable Chinese typography, and crisp controlled cyan edge highlights. Do NOT recreate their screen content or full-screen navigation. Design a beautiful distinct jackpot POPUP, straight-on flat UI screenshot, no phone mockup, no perspective.

Composition: a dark navy blue felt room backdrop, quiet and very dim, with a few subtle empty-seat circle outlines partly visible at the outer corners to establish an in-room overlay. One centered rounded rectangular popup from approximately x=60 to x=964, y=165 to y=1380. Modal edges crisp, medium-bright blue upper surfaces fading into deep blue at bottom, finely brushed glass finish, elegant thin champagne-gold rim and restrained cyan inner light, large rounded corners. No heavy 3D extrusion, no scroll bar, no oversized ornamental shield, no large empty bottom region. A small refined 8L shield mark at upper-left INSIDE the title bar, elegant centered gold title "奖池", round X close button top-right. A small diamond-and-line divider below the title. Below it, a broad 3-tab segmented strip at roughly y=310, left-to-right EXACT labels: "奖池总览" | "奖池" | "奖池记录". Selected left tab warm ivory-gold with dark blue bold text; other two tabs luminous medium blue with ivory text. All tabs same widths. Popup has excellent intentional visual hierarchy and generous but efficient spacing.

Content of overview tab: directly below tabs, a premium hero amount card at about y=415 to y=635, with a small restrained gold crown icon above label "奖池总金额", then very large centered beautiful bold tabular champagne-gold digits "3,001,800". The number must be mathematically straight, optically centered, evenly spaced and legible. No slogan, no jackpot cash or dollar/currency signs. Fine horizontal hairlines frame the central amount.
Next centered section title "各级奖池金额", small gold diamond separators on sides.
Six beautifully aligned amount cards in a 2-column by 3-row grid. Each card soft glossy azure-blue with thin luminous edges; tier label at top-left in a small restrained gold-accented pill, then large right-aligned ivory-gold amount. EXACT six cards in row order:
"1皮" — "386,800"; "2皮" — "426,000";
"5皮" — "508,000"; "10皮" — "601,000";
"20皮" — "680,000"; "50皮" — "400,000".
Grid no extraneous icons, no extra labels, not visually dense.
At bottom inside popup a quiet rounded blue note panel with small information icon, heading "奖池计入规则" and EXACT two-line text:
"每手牌盈利数额达到10倍大皮时，"
"默认计入1大皮（1大皮封顶）。"
Use comfortably readable ivory Chinese text; keep all text fully inside their boxes. This is an information-only popup, so NO claim/reward/withdraw/deposit/play/confirm button, no avatars, no bottom app navigation. Gold restraint and blue clarity, premium and fresh, substantially more attractive and readable than legacy dark UI. Text must be sharp and spelled exactly, numbers correct. No floating random decorative text, no watermark.
prompts.detailsInitial:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise-object-edit. Create the SECOND tab state of exactly the same jackpot popup shown in input image 1. Input image 1 is the base UI and authoritative visual design. Input image 2 supplies ONLY the existing game's award hand names, four-card combinations and reward ratios, never its obsolete visual style.

Keep the entire portrait canvas 1024x1536, exterior backdrop, modal x/y/size/corners/rim, 8L shield, title "奖池", divider, close button, tab strip positions and typography exactly identical to input 1. This must clearly be another tab of the same window, not a different design. The three tabs remain in the identical order "奖池总览" | "奖池" | "奖池记录". Now select the MIDDLE tab "奖池", using the same warm ivory-gold surface and dark blue lettering; left and right unselected medium blue and ivory text.

Replace only content below tabs inside the popup:
At same hero-card area as image1, show a small refined gold crown with fine horizontal rules, label "当前奖池金额", a small secondary label "底皮 1/3", and very large beautiful straight centered champagne-gold digits "386,800". Keep amount polished, optically centered and highly legible. The hero may be slightly shorter (y432-700) to give reward rows generous breathing room.
Below, a card section with heading "获奖牌型与比例" centered between small diamond separators, and a clear small header row "获奖牌型" at left and "获奖比例" at right.
Three full-width elegant blue rows, evenly stacked with a delicate horizontal divider. On left of each row a readable gold Chinese hand name; in middle EXACTLY four clean cream-white playing cards with correct traditional RED hearts/diamonds and red joker art; on right a large refined circular gold/blue ratio medallion. Cards are separate, straight-on, gently rounded, crisp, large and recognizable, never blurred or distorted. Card ranks/suits MUST be exact:
Row 1 name "天皇": red illustrated JOKER card, 3 of hearts, Q of hearts, Q of diamonds. Ratio "20%".
Row 2 name "杂皇": red illustrated JOKER card, 3 of hearts, 2 of hearts, 2 of diamonds. Ratio "10%".
Row 3 name "朵皇": Q of hearts, Q of diamonds, 2 of hearts, 2 of diamonds. Ratio "2%".
Keep natural RED suit colors and red court-card accents, no recoloring red cards to gold or blue, no black suits in these combinations. Design the payout percentages as elegant strong gold numerals, no duplicate percentage outside medallions.
At bottom a restrained blue information strip with concise text "获奖比例以对应级别奖池金额为基数". This explains the existing presentation, no new game rules. No invented buttons, no claim/reward/withdraw action, no extra tier selector, no avatars, no pagination, no "示例" watermark.
Maintain image1's luxurious medium-bright azure/teal, thin champagne-gold edges, warm ivory Chinese text, crisp cyan highlights, high-quality visual balance. All text comfortably inside panels, Chinese labels spelled exactly. The entire information content must fit inside existing modal bottom edge.
prompts.records:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise-object-edit. Produce the THIRD tab state of exactly the jackpot popup in input image1. Input1 is the authoritative base layout. Preserve canvas 1024x1536, backdrop, popup size and position, corners, outline, small 8L shield, centered title "奖池", gold divider, X close button, and all tab geometry exactly. Keep identical bright V8-new azure/teal glass, thin champagne-gold rims, warm ivory and pale gold Chinese typography, crisp controlled cyan edge lighting. This must look like one window after switching tabs, not a new screen.

The tab order remains EXACTLY "奖池总览" | "奖池" | "奖池记录". Select RIGHT tab "奖池记录" in ivory-gold with dark blue text; other two are medium blue with ivory text.

Replace only content below the tabs:
A compact premium hero "最大赢家" card from y=432 to about y=735. At the top of this card a centered heading "最大赢家" between hairline gold dividers, small crown integrated above. Below, a handsome but compact gold trophy at left (not giant, no avatar), next to it clear ivory player name "星海玩家" with a small gold-edged blue badge "天皇". Place a very large elegant champagne-gold amount "77,360" as the dominant hero figure on the right, below a small label "获奖金额". At card bottom a fine separator and centered quiet ivory time "09-14 14:28". Keep the hero compact and balanced, enough vertical room for records; no extra user ID or invented metrics.

Below, centered heading "当前奖池记录", small diamond rules on sides.
One handsome full-width rounded blue table from approx y=810 to y=1320. Header columns: "玩家" | "牌型" | "奖金" | "时间". Prefer only thin horizontal row separators, no thick boxed cell grid. Large clean Chinese names left-aligned, prize amounts gold and right-aligned, type text ivory, date/time formatted on TWO lines to prevent crowding. No avatar and no rank numbers or status column. EXACTLY five rows with the following content:
"星海玩家" | "天皇" | "77,360" | "09-14" newline "14:28"
"云山" | "杂皇" | "38,680" | "09-14" newline "13:56"
"青岚" | "朵皇" | "7,736" | "09-14" newline "13:22"
"北辰" | "杂皇" | "32,560" | "09-14" newline "12:48"
"晚风" | "朵皇" | "6,280" | "09-14" newline "12:16"
Use comfortably large and readable numbers and Chinese text, generous horizontal padding, all baseline alignments precise, more space for name and amount than type.
At bottom under table, a subtle quiet affordance with a small down chevron and caption "向上滑动查看更多". This is a vertically scrolling existing record list, NO page selector, NO date filter, NO tabs for room levels, NO claim/withdraw button, NO footer navigation or confirmations. The main popup has the same bottom edge y=1450 as input1. Do not introduce extra business functions. No watermark. Beautiful polished final-quality UI, clear gold hierarchy, refined restraint and completely consistent with the other two tab images.
prompts.cardColorCorrection:

Inputs 2 through 5 are the ACTUAL ORIGINAL PLAYING CARD SPRITES currently used by this game, loaded by PKCardInfoScript from assets/resources/pk2/. The user explicitly rejected yellow-tinted playing cards and requires the in-game ORIGINAL colors and original card designs.

Change ONLY the twelve card faces inside the three award rows of input1. Preserve every other part of input1 exactly: entire canvas 1024x1536, background, modal geometry, title, shield, tabs, gold/blue UI, labels, jackpot amount, ratio medallions, all text, all card slot positions and sizes. Do not redesign any surrounding UI.

Replace all twelve existing cream/beige/yellow card faces with clean copies faithfully matching the supplied actual game sprites: neutral white/light cool-gray paper with its subtle original texture, original thin neutral border, vivid pure RED hearts/diamonds and ranks, original BLACK linework, original queen red-and-yellow costume artwork. Do not apply the interface's gold tone, warm lighting, sepia, parchment, beige, yellow cast, gold outline, gloss, or new drawing style to ANY card paper. The queen's original yellow hair/crown should remain as in the supplied sprite, but the card PAPER MUST remain neutral gray-white. Keep original recognizable in-game joker illustration; do not substitute a different joker cartoon.

Image2 = original red JOKER (4_1a.png).
Image3 = original 3 of hearts (2_3a.png).
Image4 = original Q of hearts (2_12a.png).
Image5 = original 2 of diamonds (0_2a.png).
For Q diamonds, use the identical original Q-heart court design with its red diamond suit symbol from the base card. For 2 hearts, use the identical original original red heart card with rank 2. Paper and rendering identical to these sprites.

Place them in exact slot order:
天皇: original red JOKER, 3 hearts, Q hearts, Q diamonds.
杂皇: original red JOKER, 3 hearts, 2 hearts, 2 diamonds.
朵皇: Q hearts, Q diamonds, 2 hearts, 2 diamonds.
Maintain proportional card shapes; reproduce original card graphics, neutral paper, red/black colors as closely as a direct sprite insertion. Surrounding V8-new panels and gold typography MUST NOT change. No text changes. No watermarks.
